columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Long-running digital employees need working-memory evaluation beyond nominal token budget
columns.title_zh: 长期运行的数字员工需要超越名义 Token Budget 的 Working Memory 评估
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260902-009 after Skill 02 triage. The primary study analyzes 55 archived coding-agent trajectories and separates stored state, delivered context, memory-management work, and task/process outcome. The bounded research question is whether a long-running digital employee can be judged memory-safe or memory-effective from token budget alone, or whether governance must separately observe what is stored, what is actually delivered at execution time, and what management cost is paid. This is question-first primary research rather than a product update and passes the evidence-sufficiency gate on its own bounded empirical finding.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260902-009。该一手研究分析 55 条归档 Coding Agent Trajectory，并把 Stored State、Delivered Context、Memory-management Work 与 Task/Process Outcome 分开。边界清晰的问题是：长期运行的数字员工能否仅凭 Token Budget 判断 Memory Safety/Effectiveness，还是治理必须分别观察存储了什么、执行时实际送达了什么，以及付出了多少管理成本。该对象由问题和一手研究结果驱动，不是产品更新，并以其有界实证发现通过 Evidence Sufficiency Gate。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the 55-trajectory corpus, the four measurement layers, semantic memory-object taxonomy, retention/compression observations, calibration-transfer limits, and which claims apply only to coding-agent traces rather than all digital employees.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 55 条 Trajectory Corpus、四层测量框架、语义 Memory-object Taxonomy、Retention/Compression 观察、Calibration Transfer 局限，以及哪些结论仅适用于 Coding Agent Trace 而不能推广到所有数字员工。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Enterprise agent connectors need layered authority instead of an installed-or-enabled permission flag
columns.title_zh: 企业 Agent Connector 需要分层 Authority，而不是 Installed/Enabled 权限标志
columns.source_zh: OpenAI 官方 Release Notes，并由 Microsoft Copilot Studio 与 Codex 实现证据交叉支持
columns.reason: Selected as a comparative architecture question anchored in SIG-20260902-001 and cross-supported by SIG-20260902-002 and SIG-20260902-004. OpenAI separates plugin availability, app access, individual application sign-in and existing patient-record permissions; Microsoft exposes connector scopes on a durable agent identity but revalidates them against runtime policy; Codex scopes remembered MCP approval to the selected account link. Together these samples support a bounded architecture question that remains meaningful without vendor names: which distinct authority identities must be bound before a connector call may execute, and which layers must be revalidated at call time? This passes the release boundary because the object is the cross-sample authorization mechanism, not any release itself.
columns.reason_zh: 作为比较型架构问题选入，锚定 SIG-20260902-001，并由 SIG-20260902-002 与 SIG-20260902-004 交叉支持。OpenAI 将 Plugin Availability、App Access、个人应用登录与既有 Patient Record Permission 分开；Microsoft 将 Connector Scope 暴露在持久 Agent Identity 上，但仍由 Runtime Policy 重新校验；Codex 则把记忆的 MCP Approval 绑定到具体 Account Link。三个样本共同支持一个去掉厂商名仍成立的边界问题：Connector Call 执行前到底必须绑定哪些不同的 Authority Identity，哪些层还必须在 Call Time 重新核验？该对象研究的是跨样本授权机制，而不是任何 Release 本身，因此通过 Release Boundary。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify all three samples' exact authority layers, identify which checks occur at install/publish/session/call time, distinguish administrative enablement from principal and target-resource authority, and record where the samples are not equivalent or do not prove complete end-to-end authorization.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验三个样本各自精确的 Authority Layer，区分 Install/Publish/Session/Call Time 的检查位置，拆开 Administrative Enablement、Principal Authority 与 Target-resource Authority，并明确哪些样本并不等价、哪些证据不能证明完整端到端 Authorization。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Progressive agent skill compression must preserve routing and public entry contracts
columns.title_zh: 渐进式 Agent Skill 压缩必须保留 Routing 与 Public Entry Contract
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260902-011 after Skill 02 triage. SkillZip Pro treats production skills as progressively loaded directory bundles rather than flat prompts and reports that moderate cross-file compression can reduce bundle and per-run tokens while preserving quality, whereas an aggressively compressed configuration loses substantial accuracy. The bounded engineering question is not whether compression saves tokens, but which routing and callable-entry contracts must remain invariant so a skill bundle still behaves as the same executable capability after optimization.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260902-011。SkillZip Pro 将生产 Skill 视为渐进加载的 Directory Bundle，而非扁平 Prompt；论文报告适度的跨文件压缩可降低 Bundle 与 Per-run Token 并保持质量，而激进压缩配置会出现明显准确率损失。边界问题不是“压缩是否省 Token”，而是：优化后要让 Skill Bundle 仍表现为同一个可执行能力，哪些 Routing 与 Callable-entry Contract 必须保持不变？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the progressive-loading model, compression procedure, preserved entry/routing contracts, benchmark harness, reported token and quality deltas, aggressive-compression failure case, and limits on generalizing from the evaluated skill bundles to arbitrary tool/plugin packages.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Progressive-loading 模型、Compression Procedure、被保护的 Entry/ Routing Contract、Benchmark Harness、报告的 Token 与 Quality Delta、激进压缩失败案例，以及从被评估 Skill Bundle 推广到任意 Tool/Plugin Package 时的边界。
